title: Profile
about.text: Mina {version}. Menus are generated on your phone by deterministic rules and scores: no artificial intelligence, no servers.
changes.label: What happens if I change my preferences?
changes.text: Future meals you haven’t cooked yet are recalculated. Completed meals, purchases and pantry stay as they are. PLUS items are part of advanced personalisation: for now they’re included for everyone.
localNote: Local profile: no account, your data stays on this phone.
export.failed: Export failed. Your data hasn’t changed: please try again.
wipe.title: Delete all data?
wipe.message: Preferences, calendar, pantry, lists and history will be deleted from this phone. This can’t be undone.
wipe.confirmMessage: Do you really want to delete everything and start over from the questionnaire?
edit.title: Edit
notifications.granted: Permission granted: reminders are scheduled on this iPhone.
notifications.denied: Permission denied: Mina still works, just without alerts. You can turn them back on in iOS Settings.
notifications.unsupported: Notifications aren’t available on this platform.
notifications.scheduled: Reminders scheduled right now: {count}. They’re updated every time you open the app or change the calendar.
notifications.testSent: Test notification arriving in about 5 seconds.
notifications.iosLimit: iOS limits background activity: reminders cover the current calendar. Open Mina at least once a week to schedule the next ones.
prices.notice: Mina doesn’t know shop prices: it uses the ones you enter, with their date. They’re used to estimate the cost of recipes and shopping; estimates are only indicative.
prices.question: How much do you pay for a pack and how much does it contain?
prices.errorPrice: Enter the price you paid, for example 1.20.
prices.errorQty: Enter the pack size in {unit}, for example 500.
help.faq1.q: I’ve changed phone: how do I get my subscription back?
help.faq1.a: Open Profile → Subscription and tap “Restore purchases”, using the same Apple or Google account you used to buy it.
help.faq2.q: What about my data (plan, pantry, preferences)?
help.faq2.a: It stays on your phone. To move it to the new one, use your phone’s backup, or Profile → Your data → Export.
help.faq3.q: How do I change a meal?
help.faq3.a: In Week, tap the meal to open the recipe, or press and hold it to change it, move it or mark it.
help.faq4.q: Why doesn’t the pantry deduct ingredients?
help.faq4.a: Quantities only change when you confirm your shopping or that you’ve cooked a meal: that way the pantry stays reliable.
help.faq5.a: Check Profile → Notifications and your phone’s notification settings. Reminders are local: they work even without internet.
help.noContacts: Support contact details will be shown here before the app is published in the stores.
